metadata.scenario: A prospect inquires about costs associated with setting up a home security system. Category: New Inquiry. Outcome: quote_provided. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi, Margaret. My name is Karen Lewis, and I was referred by my husband's cardiac surgeon. Nice to meet you, Karen. How can we help with your husband's care? He will need post-operative care after his surgery next month, and I’d like to know more about the services you offer. Absolutely, we provide a range of post-surgery care services, including skilled nursing and personal care assistance. Great! What are the costs associated with those services? For post-surgery recovery care, our rates range from $85 to $110 for 1 to 3 hours of specialized care. Skilled nursing care is $95 to $125 for 1 to 2 hours. Okay, that sounds reasonable. Do you have caregivers available for daily visits? Yes, we can provide caregivers for daily visits, especially if you need ongoing support during his recovery. What would that look like? How many days would you recommend? Typically, we recommend starting with daily visits for the first week post-surgery to monitor his recovery and adjust the care plan as needed. That sounds good. Is there a way to discuss a specific schedule with someone? Yes, I can connect you with our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen, who can help develop a personalized care plan. Perfect! What’s the next step? I can take down your information and have Lisa give you a call to go over the details and set up the schedule. That would be great. Also, can you tell me about insurance coverage for these services? We assist with insurance authorization, so we can check your husband's coverage and help you navigate that process. Wonderful! What information do you need from me? I’ll need your husband's insurance details, his surgery date, and your contact information to get started. Sure, his surgery is scheduled for April 10th, and my number is +13165552147. Thank you, Karen. I’ll pass that to Lisa. She’ll reach out to you shortly to discuss the care plan. I appreciate your help. Is there anything else I should do? Just keep an eye out for Lisa's call. Feel free to reach out if you have more questions in the meantime! Thank you, Margaret. I’m looking forward to hearing from her. You’re welcome! Have a great day, Karen. You too, bye! Bye!
